displayOrder.prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, restrained typography, intentional real product imagery, and purposeful spacing. Redesign the ajigu independent app studio website, both its homepage and its Moodsk app detail page. This is a design concept preview for an experienced developer who rejected the existing crude pages. Moodsk makes and applies custom Mac folder/file icons with a layer editor. The studio has six apps: TypeNote, Moodsk, Go Sleep, DailyApod, TUTU, Nameplate Studio. Main user goal: browse apps, understand one product, and reach its download.

Generate ONE coherent design direction as ONE landscape presentation image containing TWO coordinated desktop webpage screenshots side by side: LEFT homepage, RIGHT Moodsk detail. These two pages are the same design system, not two different concepts. Target total canvas 3072x2048; each page represents a natural 1440px-wide scrollable desktop page, scaled uniformly to fit. Add only small external captions "首页" and "Moodsk 详情页" above the respective frames. Both webpage frames should show header through meaningful content and a compact FAQ/footer, without squeezed text, arbitrary cropping, annotations, or a browser/computer shell around the whole page.

HARD UI CONSTRAINT: every control and UI component must visually match standard shadcn/ui New York components: NavigationMenu, Button default/outline/ghost, Card where meaningful, Tabs only if needed, Badge sparingly, DropdownMenu language control, Separator, and Accordion for FAQ. Use their ordinary 1px neutral borders, restrained 6-8px radii, 36-40px buttons, tiny right-aligned chevrons, standard padding, subtle or no shadow. The eventual code will use official shadcn components, not custom imitations. This image is a concept, not a claim of implemented functionality. No experimental bespoke widgets, brutalism, oversized triangle bullets, black slab borders, decorative blobs, thick shadows, rainbow, giant cards enclosing the whole UI, nested cards, or huge empty FAQ gaps.

Reference image roles: images 1 and 2 show REJECTED current page styling: DO NOT COPY their typography, excessive weights, broken whitespace, or triangle FAQ controls; use them only for actual product context/content. Image 3 is current homepage, use its real product assets, names and front-view device screenshots as content only, not its rough layout. Image 4 is actual Moodsk folder editor screenshot, preserve that screenshot subject as the main product imagery; do not invent a different app UI. Image 5 is a visual context board: its left side shows the CURRENT Moodsk icon, whose blue folder/artwork identity must be preserved; its right side shows the earlier Sindre Sorhus detail-page reference. Use the latter only for clarity and product focus, not the large empty hero or promotional clutter. Product assets must look like the supplied real references. All device mockups remain upright and frontal, never tilted or scattered at angles. Retain product image aspect ratios. No enlarged generic replacement logos.

Use realistic simplified Chinese text with correct app names. Body 14-16px, captions 13-14px, feature headings around 22-26px, page heading around 40-48px and medium weight 500; comfortable Chinese line height. Avoid heavy 800/900 headings. Comfortable line lengths, compact 48-56px FAQ rows, coherent 8px spacing system, content max width around 1080px within each page. Have one clear primary download action on details "在 App Store 下载", a secondary outline action "查看功能". Detail tagline "让桌面，成为你的样子。"; brief supporting copy "制作与更换文件夹图标，把日常整理成喜欢的样子。" Native app screenshot content remains in its screenshot, not recreated as page copy. FAQ section title "常见问题", 3 compact shadcn Accordion rows for supported Macs, materials, restoring icons; one can be expanded with two short lines. No fake user counts, testimonials, prices, claims or dates. Current date anchor is 2026-11-01; only visible date if needed is copyright © 2026 ajigu. Keep content focused, not a feature inventory. No newsletter, pricing table, metrics, or invented business functionality.
DIRECTION NAME: Gallery White. A luminous, quiet, premium white gallery with a true white background and zinc-neutral shadcn tokens. Homepage: compact horizontal header ajigu at left, 作品 / 关于 / 简体中文 on right; restrained left-aligned studio intro "为日常，做一点好用的东西。" with one short sentence; below it a spacious TWO-COLUMN collection of six product tiles, subtle media surfaces, front-view device imagery, small consistent app icons, product names, and short one-line descriptions. Every tile is a standalone standard Card with extremely delicate border or clean surface, no heavy box treatment. Put imagery before text, avoid repeated CTA buttons on every tile. Footer small and calm. Moodsk detail: centered compact app identity with current icon around 72px, name, short tagline, description, black primary shadcn Button and white outline Button; immediately below a large upright actual editor screenshot in a barely tinted surface, then three concise feature summaries separated by space rather than boxes, and a full-width compact shadcn Accordion. Balance generous whitespace with no empty gaps. Clear hierarchy, visual precision and understated Apple-app craftsmanship. Only monochrome neutrals outside real app assets.

DIRECTION NAME: Warm Editorial. A distinct warm, editorial, quietly elegant stone-neutral light theme. Warm off-white page #faf9f6, white surfaces and soft stone borders, muted stone-gray body text and near-black Buttons. Ordinary shadcn components, not a luxury magazine poster; use refined sans-serif typography at medium weights, not enormous bold headings or fancy serif logos.

Homepage structure must be substantially different from a uniform gallery: a split opening composition with a narrow LEFT studio introduction "独立创作，日常使用。" and a brief thoughtful studio paragraph plus ghost "关于工作室" link; RIGHT a larger featured Moodsk product Card combining the supplied real editor image, current icon, name and concise description. Then a clearly separated "更多应用" area showing the five remaining apps in a compact THREE-COLUMN card collection with small upright product media, neat one-line labels and muted descriptions. Keep the layout balanced and useful, never empty. Minimal header ajigu / 作品 / 关于 / 简体中文, quiet footer.

Moodsk detail uses a SPLIT hero: current icon, name, short tagline and the two standard shadcn download/outline Buttons on the LEFT; a larger actual blue folder editor screenshot on the RIGHT, upright and unwarped on a lightly tinted media surface. Under the hero, three short horizontally arranged feature summaries using light separators, not heavy boxes. A narrow readable description section follows. FAQ uses a two-column SECTION, with a modest 24px title and one helpful sentence on the left, and a compact standard shadcn Accordion with thin bottom rules and tiny right-aligned chevrons on the right. Only 3 questions and one short open answer, no gigantic gaps. This paired design must feel cohesive, calm, human and polished, with soft warm color and clear text alignment. No decorative doodles, illustrations or invented content.

DIRECTION NAME: Quiet Dark Catalogue. A distinct, extremely refined dark zinc shadcn theme, near-black #09090b base, slightly lighter #18181b surfaces, subtle #27272a dividers, warm white headings, muted gray body. Native app colors are the only strong chroma; primary shadcn Buttons are ordinary off-white with dark text. No neon, no bloom, no glow, no dramatic gradients.

Homepage: a compact restrained studio introduction at the top left with "小而用心的应用。" around 36px, a short description and a small standard shadcn Tabs filter "全部 / Mac / iPhone 与 iPad". Below is a THREE-COLUMN compact product catalogue of all six apps. Each item has a modest front-view product-media area (from the actual references), then a precisely aligned row with its current app icon, name and platform, and one restrained line of accurate descriptive copy. The catalogue is lighter and denser than the white gallery; prefer grouped surfaces and delicate separators, not nested giant Card boxes. Six apps should be easy to scan in two rows, with no search box or dashboard sidebar. Header and footer stay small and elegant.

Moodsk detail: a horizontal product masthead within the centered content column — current blue app icon 64px and name/tagline LEFT, white shadcn download Button and outline action RIGHT. Below it a large single actual blue-folder editor screenshot that is the dominant content; do not surround the whole page with a card. Under the screenshot, standard compact shadcn Tabs "概览 / 功能 / 常见问题", a concise overview with 3 feature rows using icons and hairline separators, and a short compact FAQ Accordion with neutral borders. No giant centered hero block, no oversized headline and no gratuitous badges. Typography is calm, legible and medium weight. Keep all native media and devices upright/front-view and retain their native aspect ratios. This should look like a thoughtfully edited independent developer app catalogue, not a SaaS dashboard or gaming site.

scope: Three visual concepts only; each pairs homepage with Moodsk detail; no production UI change.
